gaps.desktop: Type, checkbox, icons, padding and shadow are pixel-identical, so the difference is the layout: the loser's composer card stretches to ~1110 px wide, which leaves the 4-icon action cluster (calendar/tag/checklist/flag, ~28 px icons at 64 px pitch) about 630 px right of the end of the 20 px title. The row reads as two disconnected islands. The winner caps the card at ~835 px, so the icons sit ~350 px from the title and the card reads as one compact unit. Cap the composer's max-width at ~840 px.
gaps.phone: The loser's completion checkbox (~24 px square, top-left of the card) is drawn as a ~1 px hairline, with ~30% less ink than the winner's ~1.5 px stroke. That makes it the faintest mark on the card, weaker than the ~22-27 px grey toolbar icons below it (~#A3A3A3), so the primary affordance sinks under the secondary ones. The winner's heavier ~1.5 px, ~#C4C4C4 ring holds its own next to the 22 px title. Thicken the loser's checkbox stroke to ~1.5 px.

why: Near-identical renders: desktop decided by the winner's tighter card width keeping actions close to the title; phone by the winner's stronger checkbox stroke preserving hierarchy over the toolbar icons.
